name: GENTING
recent: Genting Berhad 正在推进一项可放弃供股计划，拟筹集约 RM1,250 million，并已向 Bursa Securities 提交上市申请。同时，公司董事及主要股东在 10 月份有多笔股权变动申报。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）公司录得净亏损。
notable: 拟筹集约 RM1,250 million 总收益。
已就供股新股向 Bursa Securities 提交上市及报价申请。
董事及主要股东在 10 月份有多笔股权变动申报。
risks: 供股计划可能导致现有股东股权被摊薄。
Bursa Securities 就供股计划发出询问，要求补充说明折价依据及营运资金分配明细。
最新季度净亏损为 RM27.1 million，而上一季度为净盈利。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM7,746.1 million，环比增长 16.2%，同比增长 14.2%；但净亏损为 RM27.1 million，净利率为 -0.3%，而上一季度净利率为 1.5%。

recent_en: Genting Berhad is undertaking a renounceable rights issue to raise approximately RM1,250 million and has submitted the listing application to Bursa Securities. Meanwhile, there were multiple filings of changes in director and substantial shareholder interests in October. The latest quarter ended 30 June 2026 recorded a net loss.
notable_en: Proposed renounceable rights issue to raise gross proceeds of approximately RM1,250 million.
Listing and quotation application for the rights shares submitted to Bursa Securities.
Multiple filings of changes in director and substantial shareholder interests in October.
risks_en: The rights issue may dilute existing shareholders' equity.
Bursa Securities issued a query on the rights issue, requesting additional information on the discount basis and working capital allocation.
The latest quarter recorded a net loss of RM27.1 million, compared to a net profit in the previous quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM7,746.1 million, up 16.2% QoQ and 14.2% YoY; however, a net loss of RM27.1 million was recorded with a net margin of -0.3%, compared to a net margin of 1.5% in the previous quarter.
